decision: Retain a modular monolith, strengthen module contracts, and define extraction triggers.
assumptions: traffic and team size remain within the current regime over the review window
uncertainty: future staffing, regulatory isolation, or divergent scaling may change the architecture decision
rival_model: microservices become superior if independent scaling, isolation, or release cadence differences dominate operational overhead
falsifiers: measured deployment contention persists after module-boundary improvements
next_discriminating_action: instrument deployment coordination cost and trial independent module release inside the monolith
review_trigger: review when team size exceeds eight or deployment coordination becomes a measured top-three bottleneck
reversal_condition: extract services when independent deployment benefit demonstrably exceeds distributed-systems overhead
